title: MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES limit silently drops new parents with no feedback
description: File: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs Lines 390-394. When parent count reaches MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES (16), new parents are silently dropped with DioOutcome::Accepted. The caller has no way to know the parent was not added. Edge case: A better parent arrives when at capacity. It is rejected silently. The node stays with suboptimal routing. Consider: (1) return a distinct DioOutcome like AtCapacity, (2) replace worst existing parent, or (3) document this as intentional fail-safe behavior.
